sentences.en: Fortunately, the organizational changes did not involve any layoffs.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，组织结构的变化并没有涉及任何裁员。

sentences.en: Tom's creative thinking nicely complemented Mary's organizational talents.
sentences.zh: 汤姆的创新思维很好地补充了玛丽的组织才能。

sentences.en: Tom put his organizational skills to use and soon the office was running smoothly.
sentences.zh: 汤姆运用了他的组织能力，很快办公室就运转得井井有条。

senses.zh: 组织的，组织上的；有组织的，善于组织的
